create_tensorboard_writer: create a TensorboardWriter instance with a log directory, logger, and enabled flag
set_training_step: call set_step on TensorboardWriter to set the current step and train or valid mode
add_scalar_to_tensorboard: use TensorboardWriter add_scalar to log a scalar value with auto mode tagging
add_image_to_tensorboard: use TensorboardWriter add_image to log an image tensor with auto step and mode tagging
review_tensorboardwriter_getattr: review TensorboardWriter __getattr__ which proxies TensorBoard methods like add_histogram and add_embedding
